tables.title: MMC Counters and Associated Interrupt Registers
tables.text: Table 806, "MMC Counters and Associated Interrupt Registers", in section 76.5.6 (Time sensitive networking (TSN)) on page 4067. Columns: Frame assembly error counter, Description, Associated MMC counter. 6 data row(s).

rows:
32-bit counter providing the number of MAC 
frames with reassembly errors on the receiver 
due to a mismatch in the fragment count 
value.

MMC Rx packet assembly error register 
(ETH_RX_PACKET_ASM_ERR)

32-bit counter providing the number of 
received MAC frames rejected because they 
arrived with an SMD-C when there was no 
preceding preempted frame

MMC Rx packet SMD error register 
(ETH_RX_PACKET_SMD_ERR)

32-bit counter providing the number of MAC 
frames that were successfully reassembled

MMC Rx packet assembly OK register 
(ETH_RX_PACKET_ASM_OKR)

32-bit counter providing the number of 
additional mPackets received due to 
preemption

MMC Rx FPE fragments counter register 
(ETH_RX_FPE_FRAG_CR)

32-bit counter providing the number of 
additional mPackets transmitted due to 
preemption

MMC FPE Tx fragment counter register 
(ETH_MMC_FPE_TX_FCR)

32-bit counter containing the number of hold 
requests sent to the MAC

MMC Tx hold request counter register 
(ETH_MMC_TX_HRCR)
